_description: Regression coverage for piece.addPatternPiece's "createGroup" defaulting to true (Phase 16 -- see CHANGELOG.md's own entry): the interactive GUI's Group Manager is only ever populated by a human manually clicking its own "+" button, which this action layer has no equivalent of, so every piece it builds now gets its own matching group automatically unless the caller opts out. "PieceDefault" (no "createGroup" given at all) proves the new default itself. Each successful piece.addPatternPiece's own group's real persistence in the DOM (not just an echoed JSON field) is independently confirmed by immediately trying to create a second group under the exact same name via the plain "group" op and expecting a structured "groupExists" error -- if the piece op had only faked the group in its response without actually calling through to handleGroup()/doc->createGroup(), this second call would succeed instead. "PieceNoGroup" ("createGroup": false) proves the explicit opt-out still works with the default flipped, confirmed the same way in reverse: the follow-up "group" op under that same name must now SUCCEED, since no group was actually created for it. "PieceNamed" ("groupName": "CustomGroupName") proves the name override. "PieceM1"/"PieceM2" (built from one shared draft block, sharing points "M2"/"M3" the same way checkSharedDraftBlockMultiPieceRegression's own fixture does in tests/actionlayer/run_batch/main.cpp) prove each piece's auto-created group is scoped to only that piece's own node list -- "PieceM1"'s group must list exactly ["M1","M2","M3","M4"] and "PieceM2"'s exactly ["M2","M5","M6","M3"], with no leakage between the two despite the shared points.
